summary: BranchOut Food Inc. filed an 8-K to report the exercise of the over-allotment option in its recently closed public offering. The underwriters, led by Lake Street Capital Markets, purchased an additional 123,088 shares at $3.40 per share, adding approximately $418,500 in gross proceeds. Total offering increased to 943,676 shares and about $3.2 million in gross proceeds. This is a routine follow-up to an underwritten public offering, not a special situation. No M&A, tender, or restructuring activity is present. The filing simply confirms completion of the greenshoe, a standard capital-raising event. What to watch: potential share overhang or price action post-offering, but no special-situation angle.
